## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use both arms for the kitchenpot with two side handles

Task description: Use both arms to lift the pan at the center of the table by its two side handles, keeping its body roughly upright.

Success criteria: The pan is clearly lifted off the table, with its opening facing upward and no noticeable tilt. The left and right arm end effectors are near the graspable sections of the handles at the lower left and upper right of the current view, respectively.

## Execution tips

- Consider gripping the outer crossbar of the side handle, away from the pan wall, on a straight section clear of the corner. Let the pads contact the bar fully and leave room for the finger near the pan wall.
- Make the gripper opening slightly wider than the crossbar thickness. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the rod and the inner finger has entered the handle opening, rather than pressing only on the handle surface.
- While both arms support the pot, keep the handles at similar heights and move them together to reduce tilt. If a new grasp is needed, first ensure the pot is safely supported before releasing either gripper.
